recovery.reason: Execution workspace reset; original page-level hashes were not retained in conversation.
recovery.method: Recover review coverage from agent conversation; refetch public author PDFs and compare with original byte lengths and SHA-256 supplied by parent; regenerate page fingerprints.

coverage.review_limit: Complete extracted page text was read in the prior review; selected visual inspection covered tables, figures and algorithm/formula layouts, not all numerical values or every equation page.

fingerprint_method.pdf_hash: SHA-256 of exact downloaded PDF bytes
fingerprint_method.page_split: Split decoded UTF-8 text at U+000C; discard only the final whitespace-only trailing chunk.
fingerprint_method.page_hash: SHA-256 of each page chunk re-encoded as UTF-8, preserving whitespace and newlines, excluding the form-feed separator.
fingerprint_method.character_count: Python len() of the identical page chunk
